card.name: Long runs after p^2 with no prime factor exceeding p (p <= 10^9)

task.name: Long runs after p^2 with no prime factor exceeding p (p <= 10^9)
task.description: construct() -> {'p': p, 'k': k} with p a prime at most 10^9 and 1 <= k <= 200; every integer p^2 + 1, ..., p^2 + k must have all prime factors at most p (exact factorization by trial division and Pollard-Brent with deterministic Miller-Rabin). Maximize k. Long runs for p <= 10^9 are finite evidence for the conjectured positive answer.
task.contract: construct() -> {'p': p, 'k': k} with p a prime at most 10^9 and 1 <= k <= 200; every integer p^2 + 1, ..., p^2 + k must have all prime factors at most p (exact factorization by trial division and Pollard-Brent with deterministic Miller-Rabin). Maximize k.
